---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new mode, transform, binding, or integration
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What's the use case?**
What are you actually trying to do? (A real data shape, a real
integration target, a real link/bandwidth constraint -- concrete beats
abstract here.)

**What would you want CSA to do**
Describe the feature. If it's a new compression mode, what's the data
shape it targets, and roughly why you think it has exploitable structure
generic compression doesn't already capture?

**Have you measured anything already?**
If you have real data and rough numbers (even informal), they're more
useful here than a description alone -- this project's whole ethos is
measure-first (see `DESIGN.md`/`ADVERSARIAL_BENCHMARK.md`).

**Alternatives considered**
Any existing tool/format/library you already tried, and why it didn't fit.
